en.name: Heshang
en.ability: Each night, the first evil ability to choose your neighbour, has no effect (until next dawn). You learn that your ability triggered.

revisions.v1: Each night, the first evil ability to choose your neighbour, has no effect (until next dawn). You learn that your ability triggered.

zh.name: 和尚
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，当有邪恶玩家的能力首次选择或影响与你邻近的存活玩家时，改为此次能力不生效并持续至下个黎明，且你会得知你的能力被触发。
